limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.
Only the incremental canonical CannBot fixed-stage evidence boundary is normalized; inherited MindIE-SD guidance remains unchanged.
CannBot callback predicates do not establish numerical accuracy or performance; dependent skills, agent-host integration and NPU execution are unverified.

applicability.scope: Interpret Ascend CANN profiling evidence from step breakdown through kernel/utilization/communication analysis, and assess execution/validator evidence in automated optimization-stage reports.
applicability.prerequisites: Usable warm-state captures with representative steps, required files and non-null utilization columns; healthy cards and a consistent valid topology for multi-card comparisons.
applicability.input_contract: CANN step/kernel/utilization/communication outputs with verified column semantics; for stage acceptance, the loaded candidate, baseline, quality-validator output and comparable measurements.
applicability.produced_artifact: An evidence-qualified bottleneck classification and optimization direction; stage conclusions retain missing-execution/validator INCONCLUSIVE or observed gate-failure FAIL.
applicability.failure_modes: Summing concurrent communication durations double-counts overlap; misidentified columns can drop communication, and a successful export can still lack usable utilization data.

recommendations: Start from the step-level computing/communication/overlap/free breakdown and stop deepening the analysis once the bottleneck is located; do not sum concurrent streams as wall time.
Inspect actual column headers and enum values on the installed CANN version, then verify files and non-null metrics before interpreting utilization heuristics.
Use same-window interleaved baseline/candidate measurements on shared machines; progress markers, hashes and source-derived thresholds do not substitute for quality and execution evidence.
